# Qt CoAP C++ Classes

Provides classes to use CoAP protocol.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| qmake | `QT += coap` |

The [Qt CoAP](qtcoap-index.md) page contains information about how to use the module.


## Namespaces

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [QtCoap](qtcoap.md)| Contains miscellaneous identifiers used throughout the Qt CoAP module. |

## Classes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [QCoapClient](qcoapclient.md)| The QCoapClient class allows the application to send CoAP requests and receive replies. |
| [QCoapMessage](qcoapmessage.md)| The QCoapMessage class holds information about a CoAP message that can be a request or a reply. |
| [QCoapOption](qcoapoption.md)| The QCoapOption class holds data about CoAP options. |
| [QCoapPrivateKey](qcoapprivatekey.md)| The QCoapPrivateKey class provides an interface for managing CoAP security keys. |
| [QCoapReply](qcoapreply.md)| The QCoapReply class holds the data of a CoAP reply. |
| [QCoapRequest](qcoaprequest.md)| The QCoapRequest class holds a CoAP request. This request can be sent with QCoapClient. |
| [QCoapResource](qcoapresource.md)| The QCoapResource class holds information about a discovered resource. |
| [QCoapResourceDiscoveryReply](qcoapresourcediscoveryreply.md)| The QCoapResourceDiscoveryReply class holds the data of a CoAP reply for a resource discovery request. |
| [QCoapSecurityConfiguration](qcoapsecurityconfiguration.md)| The QCoapSecurityConfiguration class holds configuration options during the authentication process. |
